scenario.task:
I noticed unauthorized charges on my account and believe my account has been hacked

User Guide: Immediately state that your account was hacked or that you see fraudulent charges. Listen to the empathy response and accept the immediate transfer If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
